name: serverlens
description: Lightweight multi-server monitor for AI research: GPUs, CPU, memory, disks and quotas over SSH, no remote agent
author: ziyisun85-ops

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code display language

serverlens.targets.description: List of SSH hosts to monitor

serverlens.additionalHosts.description: Additional SSH targets (host alias, IP address, or user@host)

serverlens.ignoredHosts.description: List of SSH hosts to ignore

serverlens.sshTimeout.description: SSH connection and command timeout in seconds

serverlens.maxConcurrentHosts.description: Maximum number of SSH hosts queried concurrently

serverlens.pauseWhenHidden.description: Pause automatic SSH refreshes while the dashboard is hidden

serverlens.compactLayout.description: Use a dense multi-column layout for servers with many GPUs

serverlens.showPower.description: Show power draw and power limit

serverlens.showFanSpeed.description: Show fan speed when reported by the GPU

serverlens.showProcesses.description: Show GPU processes, owners, PIDs, and memory usage in a collapsible section

serverlens.showHostHealth.description: Show lightweight CPU load, RAM, root disk, uptime, and SSH latency metrics

serverlens.enableSlurmIntegration.description: Automatically associate GPU processes with Slurm jobs when Slurm is available

serverlens.slurmRefreshInterval.description: Seconds between Slurm job metadata refreshes

serverlens.availabilityRequireNoProcesse.description: Require a GPU to have no compute processes before it is considered available

serverlens.availabilityMaxMemoryMiB.description: Maximum used GPU memory in MiB for an available GPU

serverlens.availabilityMaxUtilization.description: Maximum GPU utilization percentage for an available GPU

serverlens.showStatusBar.description: Show aggregate GPU availability in the VS Code status bar

serverlens.enableNotifications.description: Show notifications when a GPU first crosses a warning threshold

serverlens.notificationEvents.description: State transitions that may produce notifications when notifications are enabled

serverlens.notificationCooldownSeconds.description: Minimum time between ServerLens notification batches

serverlens.memoryWarningThreshold.description: Memory usage percentage that triggers warning styling

serverlens.temperatureWarningThreshold.description: Temperature in Celsius that triggers warning styling

serverlens.powerWarningThreshold.description: Power limit percentage that triggers warning styling

serverlens.researchUser.description: Remote username used by the My tasks filter.

serverlens.visibleGpus.description: Visible GPU indices or UUIDs per SSH host. Omitted host = all GPUs; empty list = none. Affects display only.

scripts.dev: npm run compile && node scripts/renderPreview.js && python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test: node scripts/checkLocales.js && node ./out/test/manual_test.js && node scripts/checkRefresh.js && npm run preview:build && node scripts/checkWebview.js
